name: Charlottesville city, VA
findings: Charlottesville city has 5 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
